name: privacy-first-site-builder
description: Privacy-first full-stack Website Builder, CMS, and SaaS admin platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cms/api" "npm run dev -w @cms/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cms/shared && npm run build -w @cms/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @cms/api && npm run build -w @cms/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cms/api && npm run lint -w @cms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cms/plugin-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @cms/api && npm run typecheck -w @cms/web
